_about: Where's My Car, as plain data. From Friday on, the beater by the gate turns out not to be yours. You have your keys: press the fob anywhere in the Parking Lot and walk toward the chirp (the game tells you warmer or colder, and your car's lights flash). At the car a card game is on the hood. Then you get in and drive it, in the real world, out of the lot, through the gate and down to the marked spot beside your camp ('park'). It pulls left, it stalls when you hit something hard, and people do not get out of the way. 'memories' is the old version (three wrong memories to walk to); the game no longer uses it, but its van, towel and row signs still stand in the lot.
opening: There it is. Right by the gate, exactly where I left it.
…That is a brown hatchback. I drive a pink wagon. How do you lose a pink wagon?
Every festival is the same festival. Same field. They roll it up and move it. Your car's fine. The FIELD moved.
Then press the button and walk at whatever answers. Love you.

memories.name: The purple van
memories.memory: You parked next to a purple van.
lines: You were next to a purple van? Friend, look around. Purple is the colour this year.
Also this one was green on Thursday. My cousin had the paint.
So it could be any van.
It could be no van. Vans leave. That's the thing about vans.

memories.name: The flag
memories.memory: There was a flag. A sun on it. Or a bird.
lines: It was a flag on Thursday. It had a sun on it.
It had a sun on it because it was in the sun. Now it's a towel. Things change, honey.
You look like somebody patting the wrong pocket.
memories.learned: Not the flag. It was a towel the whole time.

memories.name: The row sign
memories.memory: Row 4. Or Row 7. There was definitely a number.
lines: Which row do you want it to be?
Row 4, Row 7, Row Pi and Row 4 Again. Dad said find something to do.
memories.learned: Not the row. There are no rows. There is a kid.

fobThought: Three memories, three dead ends. You pat your pockets the way the Towel Lady said. Left pocket: lint. Right pocket: your car keys. They have been there since Thursday.
fobLines: Somewhere out in the lot, a car goes chirp-chirp.
Chirp-chirp. It sounds pleased with itself.
found: Raise you two zip ties. …Oh. Is this your table?
We thought it was the lot's car. It's been very welcoming.
It was by the gate. I parked by the gate.
And where's the gate now? Exactly. Your hoodie's on the back seat, we didn't touch it. There's a lot of change in the cup holder. We touched some of that.
fobWarmer: Chirp-chirp. Louder. You are getting closer.
fobNear: CHIRP-CHIRP. Right here. Lights flashing. There is a card game on your hood.
foundCard: Your pink wagon. $%CASH% from the cup holder, mostly in coins, and your hoodie off the back seat: the small hours will not chill you any more. Now get it out of here: get in and drive it to the spot marked beside your camp.
driveHelp: W goes, S brakes and backs up, A and D steer. It pulls to the left. It always has. Nobody out here is going to move for you.
bumps: Thunk. The engine dies. It does that.
Crunch. That was already dented. Probably.
The engine coughs and quits. Give it a second.

parked.clean: Parked at your camp without a scratch on anybody. The cassette clicks over to side B. Your car lives here now.
parked.dinged: Parked at your camp, with %N% new dent%S% from the drive. The cassette clicks over to side B. Your car lives here now.
